limits: Each engine READY proves its two initial synchronized tics and peer barrier, not a person seeing, hearing or physically controlling the game.
Runtime counter intervals are reported when available; release cadence and human gameplay acceptance remain separate.
Memory lines are informational snapshots, not allocation-failure proof. STARTUP_FAILED is a failure receipt even when firmware logs it at INFO severity.

Screenshot transport receipts bind raw RGB565 bytes separately from the PNG file hash. Captured frames require image inspection before visual acceptance; capture alone does not prove a person saw the panel.
Request duration includes client work, holds and waits; a screenshot also includes transfer and encoding. Both-unit commands run sequentially, so the total is not per-unit UI latency.
Peer departure is claimed only where a PLAYER_LEFT receipt is present; quit commands alone are not graceful-exit proof.
The last debug response is the last received reply, which may predate a later engine load, error or reboot; shell-ready serial receipts and boot versions are recorded separately.
Prior incomplete 0.60 and failed 0.61 runs remain preserved as separate historical records.

Raw captures remain ignored local files. Published excerpts strip binary debug/discovery traffic, MAC addresses, numeric route/lobby fields and serial port paths; correlated session/capture IDs and local image paths are retained.

observations.menu: Both displayed the complete 12-choice game grid. Both selected Blast Circuit, returned to Game selection, selected Arena, and followed Connection to Host/Join. Back and Local Wi-Fi reselection worked on both in two subsequent cycles.
observations.wifi: Cold logged mode 0 to mode 1 took 2460 ms on each unit. A captured the Starting Local Wi-Fi feedback; B captured ready Host/Join after reselection. A persistent menu hang was not reproduced in these tested interactions.
observations.screenshots: Five captures each reconstructed all 900 RGB565 chunks, matched their raw SHA-256 receipts, and reproduced the saved PNG bytes exactly. The two requested lobby screenshots were unavailable during the reported physical Start transition: A stopped after 304 chunks; B could not begin. Neither produced a claimed lobby image.
observations.engine: Session 12b4f80e matched A host slot 0 and B client slot 1, two players, Arena map 1. A engine READY at 631695 ms and B at 633377 ms prove the initial synchronized barrier. They do not establish sustained gameplay.
observations.failure: A first reported PLAYER_LEFT slot 1 at 636379 ms, 4684 ms after its own READY; another PLAYER_LEFT was logged at 648380 ms. B reported P4 multiplayer peer disconnected, aborted at PC 0x40006ff1, and rebooted. B emitted no runtime STATS.
observations.remaining_host: A emitted five STATS receipts beginning at 642949 ms, after its first PLAYER_LEFT; those frames describe the remaining host alone, not two-player gameplay.
observations.quit_and_recovery: After remote quit navigation, A logged CLEANUP complete=1 retained=0 at 688481 ms and EXIT status=confirmed cleanup_complete=1 at 688484 ms, then rebooted to Home. B recovered to Home after its abort. Final status on both was mode=shell page=0 with neutral input.
observations.command_errors: The screenshot cancellations, missing final release reply across A quit/reboot, and stale close sessions are preserved. Final status and close replies show active=false, touch=false, buttons=0 and zero input/session leases.
observations.untested: B hosting, sustained two-player movement/firing, sound, and release cadence were not accepted in this failed run.
